title: The Exploration of the Promised Land
description: At Kadesh-Barnea, the people asked Moses to send men ahead to explore the land. Moses chose twelve men, one from each tribe, who went up into the hill country and reached the Valley of Eshcol. They returned with fruit from the land and reported that the land the Lord was giving them was good. Nevertheless, the people refused to go up; they complained in their tents and said that the Lord hated them, fearing the fortified cities and the sons of Anak.
